tools.name: forensics_info
tools.description: FREE. Service directory for the On-chain Forensics MCP server: endpoint catalog, chains supported (Base, Ethereum, XRPL), pricing, tokenized-equity aliases (btsla, bcspx, rlusd, bitstamp-usd, ...) and usage examples.

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: $0.02. Token verdict card for any ERC-20 on Base or Ethereum (address+chain), any registered alias (token=btsla|ondo|edel|...), or any XRPL issued currency (chain=xrp + issuer + currency): activity score 0-100, verdict tier (RED_HOT/HEAVY_FIRE/ACTIVE/THIN/SUSPICIOUS_THIN/DORMANT), transfers, unique

tools.name: settle_safe
tools.description: $0.02. FLAGSHIP pre-trade settle-safe screen for AI agents trading tokenized equities/RWAs: canonical-asset check against the verified registry (EVM: btsla/bcspx/bnvda/aapl/nvda/usdy/ousg/...; XRPL issuers: rlusd, gatehub-usd, bitstamp-usd/eur), freeze/clawback flags, trustline breadth, optional cou

tools.name: wallet_screen
tools.description: $0.05. Wallet trust screen for any wallet on Base, Ethereum or XRPL (chain=xrp): balance, tx count, flows, top counterparties, contract-interaction risk, trust tier. For XRPL also trustlines and issuer screens.

tools.name: token_profile
tools.description: $0.05. Full ERC-20 forensics profile on Base or Ethereum: exact 24h net supply change, recent mint/burn events, holder concentration, top transfers, whale moves.

tools.name: diligence_memo
tools.description: $0.25 composed Token Due-Diligence Memo (decision-grade, reproducible, no LLM calls): verdict + supply/flow forensics + settle-safe screen + narrative risk assessment. $0.35 when counterparty is provided (adds the settlement counterparty trust screen). EVM or XRPL.
